name: aa-miltank
question: A/A placebo: two identical MILTANK arms. The residual difference must read zero. It tests the assignment, the rating capture and the per-arm bookkeeping before a real A/B spends series.
assignment: per series, sha256(seed|k|arm) mod 2 over the sorted arm ids (solver/rotom/ladder.js assign); committed before the first game
metric: per-series residual r = S - E from the server's pre-series ratings; ties S = 0.5
burn_in: series below a 1300 pre-series rating are burn-in

sprt.statistic: mean(r | A) - mean(r | B), normal approximation, sigma_r = 0.5

headline: mean rating over the last N >= 100 series +- SD. Never the peak.
